name: io.github.NoaCG/noacg
title: NoaCG Broadcast Graphics and Playout
description: Make broadcast graphics for NoaCG Studio and play them out live on CasparCG, OBS, vMix or OGraf.

environmentVariables.name: NOACG_URL
environmentVariables.description: The NoaCG deployment to use. Defaults to https://noacg.studio.

environmentVariables.name: NOACG_AGENT_KEY
environmentVariables.description: A scoped agent key for saving graphics without noacg login, for CI.
